ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used for #anchor-links on the page. Use letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

SectionHeading.helper: Optional. Main heading for this section.

SectionIntro.helper: Optional. Short supporting text below the heading. Basic Formatted text and links are allowed.
SectionIntro.placeholder: Programs designed to be modular and responsive to your group's current state.

Eyebrow.helper: Optional. Short label shown on the right side of the heading row. Basic Formatted text and links are allowed.

Cards.helper: Add as many cards as you want. Only the first 3 cards are rendered on the page.

Title.helper: Required. Card heading. Basic Formatted text and links are allowed.

Icon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

Body.helper: Required. Main card copy. Basic Formatted text and links are allowed.
Body.placeholder: A sequence of 'invitations' designed to slow the heart rate and open the senses...

Link.helper: Optional. If added, the entire card becomes clickable.

Tags.helper: Optional. Add short bullet-style highlights. Basic Formatted text and links are allowed.

items.helper: Enter the items to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.
